title: Parallel Logic Expert with Operator Routing
tools: AI Reasoning (Mixture of Experts, Fuzzy Logic) · Machine Learning (PyTorch)
blurb: A mixture-of-experts transformer with fuzzy-logic operators; the fusion head gained 1.4 points in every seed, but the operators added nothing over a matched control.
long: Built a mixture-of-experts transformer that routes token representations through specialized logical operators, differentiable AND, OR and NOT. Added cross-attention between the main model and those reasoning paths, then built the PyTorch training and evaluation pipeline.

Pre-registered the evaluation and ran it over three seeds. The parallel branch with its fusion head beats the linear-head baseline by 1.4 pp in every seed, at a standard error of 0.2 pp. A parameter-matched control with the same capacity and no logic operators does just as well on ProofWriter and MNLI, so the gain comes from the fusion-head path, not from the logic operators.

Routing diagnostics show which operators the router actually uses at each depth: routing entropy stays at 97 to 98% of its maximum and the learned fusion weight shrinks, so the model routes close to uniformly and down-weights the branch. The project page has the full paper and an interactive playground.
highlights: +1.4 pp over the linear head in all 3 seeds
Logic operators = parameter-matched control (an honest null)
